verdict.rationale: Baseten documents async inference on deployed models: it returns a request ID quickly and completes later via webhook or polling, and the docs say this suits batch work. Nothing in the evidence shows any batch or async pricing discount versus real-time; the only documented discount is for cached input tokens, which is unrelated. Missing for 10: a documented batch/async discount versus real-time pricing, a dedicated batch-job submission API, and independent hands-on corroboration.
